{'text': "The pregnant star of 'The Odyssey' recently revealed that her doctor ordered her to avoid appearing on the viral YouTube show 'Hot Ones' while promoting her new movie 'Verity.'"}

{'text': "The show's premise has celebrities eating progressively spicier chicken wings while answering host Sean Evans' probing questions about their lives and careers."}

{'text': "Hathaway noted during a weekend episode of the 'Talk Of The Townsends' podcast that her character in 'Verity' appears on 'Hot Ones,' and she ate three actual wings on set before switching to 'prop wings.'"}

{'text': '"I was actually going to do \'Hot Ones\' to promote this film because it made the most sense," Hathaway said. "But then I found out I was pregnant and the doctor said no because it could send me into early labor."'}

{'text': "The 'Devil Wears Prada' star couldn't help but burst into laughter at that."}

{'text': "Hathaway added that she's hoping to appear on the show next year and chug milkshakes while dropping F-bombs."}

{'text': "Hathaway said during a June interview with Access Hollywood that she and her husband, Adam Shulman, had 'zero expectations' of her getting pregnant at age 43."}

{'text': '"We\'re really happy because, you know, from our own personal experience, we know that it isn\'t always as easy as one might hope or assume," she said. "Sometimes it just doesn\'t happen the way you want it to, or when you want it to. And we just feel really, really grateful and we don\'t take it for granted, not even for a second."'}
